reviews.title: Best aio I've owned so far
reviews.comment: Great performance for the price. Keeps my ryzen 7 5800x3d under 60 degrees under full load. It was easy to install and felt heavy and well built. The fact that you can load any custom gif is a bonus. Before this I would thermal throttle at about 90 degrees in certain games(Greyzone warfare/Cod) . Its worth the price just for the cooling and it looks dope.
reviews.author: AverageTechy

reviews.title: Don't hesitate to buy!!!
reviews.comment: I'm used to having Lian Li as a aio or case fans but thermalright is the way to go. Simple and straight forward. Even the mounting hard basically tells you what platform it is. Only con I have to say is all the cables to cable manage but other than that it's great, works extremely well and priced more than fair for what you get. Will be using thermalright for any other build.
reviews.author: Marcus L

reviews.title: You won’t be disappointed
reviews.comment: I don’t know how they pulled this off at this price point, but well done. Only thing I can see being a downside is the purple accent on the block. I like it, it matches my build, but it’s not gonna be for everybody. All in all, this is a really nice setup. Temps are great, it’s quiet, nice build quality. The lcd is an especially nice touch at this price point. I wasn’t sure I even wanted that…but it’s pretty cool.. This feels like one of those rare times you get more than you expected. That’s exceedingly rare these days.
reviews.author: Ashley Smith
